name: Adly Ehab
title: Web & AI Automation Developer
summary: Web and AI automation developer based in Cairo, Egypt. I build websites, online stores and web systems, and connect them to AI and automation. I have shipped real products for clients and businesses, including a CRM that handles 500+ leads a day, desktop automation tools for Facebook, X and Telegram, and several Arabic-first products with full right-to-left support.

projects.name: LEADORA CRM
projects.text: CRM for Arabic sales teams: seven-stage sales pipeline, multi-channel lead intake and role-based executive dashboards (PHP, MySQL, JavaScript).

projects.name: Volume 4T
projects.text: Company website with an integrated CRM tracking 500+ leads a day, plus an LLM assistant for the CEO.

projects.name: FBAUTO
projects.text: Windows desktop app that pulls leads from Facebook posts and groups, scores them by buying intent and exports them to Excel.

projects.name: X Engine
projects.text: Desktop dashboard for X outreach: scrapes communities and keyword searches, classifies posts with rules or AI, sends DMs and schedules posts (Python, Flask, Playwright).

projects.name: Telegram Members Manager
projects.text: Python desktop app for managing Telegram sessions, collecting group members, adding them to groups, and messaging with a local inbox.

projects.name: SCO4M & Wahm
projects.text: Arabic-first platforms: a social media services store with automatic order dispatch and a reseller API, and a digital subscriptions store.
